title: Take the final node at each depth
invariant: With left children queued before right children, the final node removed from a level is its rightmost node.

frames.explanation: The root enters the FIFO queue at depth zero. An empty tree starts with an empty queue and result.

frames.explanation: Freeze the queue length before processing depth 1. Only those nodes belong to this level; newly added children wait.

scene.description: normal tree after level_start; queue [0]; current index -1; depth 1; level []; result []

frames.explanation: Remove node index 0 with value 7, then append its existing children left to right. The queue becomes [1,2].

scene.description: normal tree after visit; queue [1,2]; current index 0; depth 1; level [7]; result []

frames.explanation: Commit the last value processed at this depth; left-to-right enqueue order makes it the rightmost value.

scene.description: normal tree after level_end; queue [1,2]; current index -1; depth 1; level [7]; result [7] The rightmost node at depth 1 is marked as the result.
